refText: Members of the jury, you must decide this case only on the evidence you have heard in this courtroom, and on nothing else.

male.label: deep male judge
male.instruct: Adult male, late fifties, deep resonant baritone, unmistakably masculine chest voice, slow measured courtroom authority, no breathiness, no youthful lift, English.

male.label: firm male counsel
male.instruct: Adult male, mid-forties, low firm tenor-baritone, unmistakably male, crisp courtroom advocacy, confident and precise, English.

male.label: gravel male witness
male.instruct: Adult male, early fifties, slightly gravelly low voice, unmistakably masculine, plainspoken and grounded, English.

male.label: flat male officer
male.instruct: Adult male, late thirties, mid-low masculine police-report delivery, dry and even, no soft feminine overtones, English.

male.label: warm male juror
male.instruct: Adult male, early forties, warm low conversational voice, clearly male timbre, thoughtful and steady, English.

male.label: blunt male juror
male.instruct: Adult male, mid-thirties, blunt mid-low masculine speech, short cadence, no softness in the upper register, English.

male.label: elder male juror
male.instruct: Older adult male, sixties, deeper slower masculine voice with mild age grain, dignified and clear, English.

male.label: tense male accused
male.instruct: Adult male, mid-forties, tense lower register, unmistakably male, restrained emotion under pressure, English.

male.label: clear male expert
male.instruct: Adult male, late thirties, clear mid-low explanatory voice, masculine and clinical, English.

male.label: even male clerk
male.instruct: Adult male, early thirties, even mid-low procedural voice, plainly male, unhurried, English.

male.label: young male juror
male.instruct: Adult male, mid-twenties, lower youthful male voice still clearly masculine, not boyish, English.

male.label: calm male narrator
male.instruct: Adult male, forties, calm low documentary narrator, rich masculine resonance, neutral and listenable, English.

female.label: clear female narrator
female.instruct: Adult female, mid-thirties, clear mezzo voice, unmistakably feminine, calm podcast narrator, warm and articulate, English.

female.label: sharp female counsel
female.instruct: Adult female, late thirties, sharp bright mezzo-soprano, unmistakably female, precise courtroom advocacy, English.

female.label: warm female counsel
female.instruct: Adult female, early forties, warm lower-female register that remains clearly feminine, persuasive and steady, English.

female.label: soft female witness
female.instruct: Adult female, late twenties, soft higher feminine voice, careful and sincere, no masculine chest dominance, English.

female.label: firm female witness
female.instruct: Adult female, mid-forties, firm feminine alto-mezzo, composed and direct, clearly female, English.

female.label: plain female juror
female.instruct: Adult female, mid-thirties, plain conversational female voice, natural and unforced, English.

female.label: hesitant female juror
female.instruct: Adult female, early thirties, hesitant lighter feminine voice, thoughtful pauses, clearly female, English.

female.label: blunt female juror
female.instruct: Adult female, late thirties, blunt bright female voice, clipped certainty, no deep male colouring, English.

female.label: elder female juror
female.instruct: Older adult female, early sixties, mature feminine voice with gentle age, clear and measured, English.

female.label: cool female officer
female.instruct: Adult female, mid-thirties, cool professional female voice, report-like delivery, unmistakably feminine, English.

female.label: strained female accused
female.instruct: Adult female, early forties, strained but clearly female mid voice, controlled under pressure, English.

female.label: bright female clerk
female.instruct: Adult female, late twenties, bright feminine procedural voice, tidy and audible, English.
